Tour.WelcomeMessage: 🎉 Welcome to Fine3D application! With this guided tour, you can learn all the features of the application. Let's get started!
Tour.MainSceneDescription: This is the main scene area. Here you can explore the 360° view of your project. You can navigate through the scene by dragging with the mouse and discover different angles of the project.
Tour.UnitDrawerDescription: This is the unit drawer panel. Here you can view all available units in the project, access their details, and select your preferred units.
Tour.UnitDrawerFiltersDescription: These are the unit filters. You can filter units by room count, floor range, area size, status and direction to find units that meet your needs.
Tour.StageDrawerDescription: This is the project stages panel. Here you can view all construction stages of the project. Each stage shows block and unit counts. Click on any stage to explore that specific construction phase.
Tour.StageDrawerItemsDescription: These are the stage selection cards. Each card represents a different construction stage with detailed information about blocks and units in that phase.
Tour.SidebarMenuDescription: This is the right sidebar menu. From here you can access different view modes, gallery, map and info cards.
Tour.DrawerToggleDescription: This is the right panel open/close button. In this panel you can see detailed information about the selected area.
Tour.HomeButtonDescription: This is the home view button. You can always use it to return to the main scene.
Tour.GalleryButtonDescription: This is the gallery button. Click to view photos and images related to the project.
Tour.InfoButtonDescription: This is the info cards button. Use it to see detailed information about the project.
Tour.MapButtonDescription: This is the map button. It displays the project's location information on the map.
Tour.LanguageButtonDescription: This is the language change button. You can switch between Turkish and English.
Tour.ViewerToolbarDescription: This is the top toolbar. Here you'll find the logo, day/night mode, polygon visibility, compass and contact buttons.
Tour.NavigationControlsDescription: These are the navigation controls. You can quickly switch to different angles of the scene with the left and right arrows.
Tour.NavigationLeftDescription: This is the left navigation button. Click this arrow to go to the previous view angle and explore the scene from different perspectives.
Tour.NavigationRightDescription: This is the right navigation button. Click this arrow to go to the next view angle and continue exploring the scene from new perspectives.
Tour.NavigationArrowsDescription: These are the navigation arrow buttons. The left arrow takes you to the previous view angle, and the right arrow takes you to the next view angle. Use these to quickly explore different perspectives of the scene.
Tour.SceneUsageDescription: Now let's learn how to use the scene! 🖱️ You can rotate 360° by dragging with the mouse. 🎯 Colored areas (polygons) are clickable detail areas - you can click on them to get information about that area.
Tour.TourCompletedDescription: 🎉 Congratulations! Now you know how to use the Fine3D application. If you want, you can restart this tour by clicking the help button in the bottom right corner. Happy exploring! ✨
